title: Review: Functions
concept: Review function fundamentals: defining, calling, returning, void vs value-returning, and best practices.
why: Functions are the primary unit of code organization. Writing good functions is the mark of a skilled programmer.
tips: Prefer tail expressions for simple return values
Early returns for edge cases, tail expression for the main path
common_mistakes: Functions that do too many things
Inconsistent return types across code paths
Too many parameters — consider grouping into a type
